records.text: Dave attended a classic car event recently before 23 March 2023, where many classic cars were on show; he spoke with owners and heard their stories, and found it inspiring.
Dave is a car lover and was in awe at the classic car event; he found the experience super inspiring.
On 23 March 2023, Calvin told Dave he had just had a big life change and shared a photo of a building with a sign on the front, describing it as his new mansion.
Calvin has a new mansion as of 23 March 2023; the shared photo shows a building with a sign on the front.
Calvin and Dave have talked before and greeted each other warmly on 23 March 2023; they are acquaintances.
On 2023-03-23 at 11:53 am, Dave congratulated Calvin on Calvin's big change and asked what inspired Calvin to start this journey.
On 2023-03-23, Calvin said he is excited to learn about Japanese culture and sees it as a chance to expand.
On 2023-03-23, Dave told Calvin that learning about new cultures is awesome and asked Calvin whether Calvin had ever been to Japan.
As of 2023-03-23, Calvin has never been to Japan.
On 2023-03-23, Calvin said he is fascinated by Japanese traditions and cannot wait to get a taste of Japanese culture.
On 2023-03-23, Dave said Japan sounds amazing and that he cannot wait to hear all about Calvin's Japan plans.
On 2023-03-23, Dave asked Calvin when Calvin is leaving for Japan.
As of 2023-03-23, Calvin intends to learn about Japanese culture and get a taste of the culture; Calvin had not specified a departure date, though Dave asked when Calvin is leaving.
Calvin is heading to Japan next month (April 2023), will stay there for a few months, and then go to Boston afterward.
On 2023-03-23, Calvin shared a photo of a living room with a couch, a table, and a television, showing the nice place he will be staying in Japan; Dave said it looked cozy.
Calvin's agent found him the awesome place he will stay at in Japan; Calvin said he is very thankful.
Calvin's plans for his Japan trip are to explore the city, try different local cuisines, and perhaps collaborate with musicians in the area.
Dave said having a place to stay is key and that collaborating with local musicians would be an amazing experience; he called Calvin's plans great.
On 2023-03-23, Dave shared a photo of a park with a lake and a few boats with Calvin, described it as beautiful and calming, and asked Calvin if he had been there before.
Calvin has never been to the park with a lake and boats that Dave shared and recommended on 2023-03-23.
Calvin plans to check out the park with a lake and boats that Dave recommended when Calvin is back from his Japan trip.
On 2023-03-23, Dave told Calvin he could not wait for Calvin to return from his trip, offered more recommendations if needed, and told Calvin to have fun.
On 2023-03-23, Calvin thanked Dave, said he would let Dave know if he needed help, and told Dave to stay safe.
Calvin told Dave he got a new car and is thrilled; owning a luxury car was a dream come true for him.
Calvin's new car is a red sports car; he describes it as super smooth, real powerful, and like being a rockstar behind the wheel. It is his first luxury car.
Calvin took his new red sports car for a ride on 2023-03-25 and shared a photo of it parked on the side of the road.
Calvin feels an adrenaline rush every time he gets in his new red sports car and says he is on cloud nine, believing he deserves it after all his hard work.
Dave congratulated Calvin on the new car, saying it looks awesome and that Calvin deserved it.
Dave attended a music festival in Boston on the weekend of 2023-03-18 to 2023-03-19; many cool bands played and the atmosphere was electric, and it reminded him why he loves music.
Dave shared a photo of a large crowd of people at a concert from the Boston music festival he attended.
Calvin asked Dave which band at the Boston music festival was his favorite; Dave has not yet answered.
Dave's favorite band is Aerosmith.
Dave saw Aerosmith live at the Boston music festival the weekend of 2023-03-18 to 2023-03-19; he called their performance incredible and said seeing them live was an amazing experience.
Dave did not get to hang out with Aerosmith after the show, but seeing them live was cool enough for him.
Dave shared a photo of the concert stage with a large eagle on it during Aerosmith's performance.
Dave shared a photo of two people on stage with guitars and a microphone.
Calvin said he loves Aerosmith.
Calvin thinks seeing your favorite singers live must be wild and is glad Dave got to experience it.
Dave said it is always a dream to see your favorites performing live.
Calvin wrote new tunes and had a few studio sessions in the week before 2023-03-26 (2023-03-19 to 2023-03-25).
Calvin is excited to collaborate on music and plans to share his new tunes with everyone and keep Dave updated on how his collaborations go.
Dave is looking forward to hearing Calvin's new tunes and asked Calvin to keep him updated on the collaborations.
Calvin attended a music festival in Tokyo on/about 20 April 2023; he did not see any bands but met many talented artists and music industry people, and found it totally enriching.

At the Tokyo music festival, Calvin learned a lot and got great advice from music industry professionals; a producer advised him to stay true to himself and sound unique, which motivated him to think about the direction of his music.
Calvin dreams of touring the world, performing for different people, connecting with them, and reaching a global audience with music that makes an impact.
Calvin is currently involved in the Frank Ocean tour and plans to travel to Boston after finishing it; he is excited about Boston's music scene.

Dave offered to show Calvin around Boston and its cool spots, naming Paradise Rock, House of Blues and Fenway Park as great music venues, and said he would be in the front row when Calvin performs there.
Dave shared a photo of a city skyline with a boat in the water (Boston), and Calvin replied that Boston looks great and thanked him for the tips.
Dave attended a car show last weekend (the weekend of 2023-04-15 to 2023-04-16), where he enjoyed classic cars.
Dave loves classic cars and admires the dedication people put into restoring them; this is why he is into auto engineering.
Dave shared a photo of a green Mustang parked in a field of grass, calling it a beautiful car.
Calvin shared a photo of his red sports car on display at a show and said he put a lot of work into it; he also said Dave's green Mustang photo looked great.
Dave plans to show Calvin some classic cars when Calvin visits Boston; Calvin is looking forward to seeing more cars when he is in Boston.
Dave asked Calvin whether he had had a chance to check out Boston apart from the gigs.
As of 20 April 2023, Calvin has not yet explored Boston beyond his gigs, having been busy with rehearsals and traveling.
Calvin plans to explore Boston when he visits, trying delicious food and visiting popular attractions, and suggested he and Dave grab a bite together.
Dave agreed to get food with Calvin in Boston and to show him Dave's favorite spots in the city.
Calvin is looking forward to trying Boston's food together with Dave and expects it to be fun.
Dave is excited to show Calvin the music and food in Boston and is looking forward to seeing him soon.
Dave calls Calvin by the nickname 'Cal'.
On 1 May 2023 Dave told Calvin he had finally opened his own car maintenance shop, fulfilling a long-held dream; he said it was satisfying to have a spot to work on cars.
On 1 May 2023 Dave shared a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front of it to show Calvin his new car maintenance shop.
On 1 May 2023 Calvin congratulated Dave on opening his own car maintenance shop and shared a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage.
Dave's dream was to open his own car maintenance shop; he sees the shop as a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars.
Dave loves classic cars for their design and engineering and their unique charm; he says he is obsessed with them.

On 1 May 2023 Dave shared a photo of the engine of a classic car he restored, showing a small air filter; he described the restoration as a challenging but worthwhile labor of love and was thrilled to bring the car back to life.
On 1 May 2023 Calvin shared a photo of a book with a space theme on it.
On 1 May 2023 Calvin shared a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot.

Calvin told Dave he has guts and ambition for achieving his dream; both agreed it feels amazing and satisfying when hard work, dedication and passion pay off and something you created from scratch comes to life or resonates with people.
On 2023-05-01, Calvin encouraged Dave to keep going for it; Dave said he would.
On 2023-05-01, Dave shared a photo of his shop showing a group of people standing in front of a car and invited Calvin to come by Dave's shop sometime.
Calvin said Dave's shop looks great and that Calvin would love to check it out sometime; Calvin asked what sort of cars Dave works on at the shop.
Dave works on all kinds of cars at his shop, from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars; this keeps Dave busy and happy.
Calvin said that working on cars must be really rewarding for Dave.

Dave is passionate about working on cars; Dave finds doing it every day rewarding, finds seeing the transformation awesome, and finds helping people keep their cars in good condition really satisfying.
Calvin praised Dave, saying that doing something you love and helping others is so rewarding, and encouraged Dave to keep up the great work.
Dave thanked Calvin, whom Dave called 'Cal', and said he appreciated the boost; Dave said it means a lot that his work is valued and brings joy to others.
Calvin told Dave it is awesome to see Dave doing his thing and making a difference, and said Dave's hard work and talent deserve recognition; Calvin called Dave 'bud'.
On 2023-05-01, Calvin shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant and said it was stunning.
As of 2023-05-01, Dave calls Calvin 'Cal', and Calvin calls Dave 'bud'.
On 2023-05-01 at 6:24 pm, Dave complimented Calvin's necklace and asked Calvin where he got it.
Calvin received his necklace as a gift from another artist, and he considers it a great reminder of why he keeps hustling as a musician.
Dave told Calvin to keep pushing and making music, saying it will remind them why they keep hustling.
Calvin said the road can be hard, but remembering why they are doing it keeps them going, and he suggested he and Dave keep each other motivated.
Calvin suggested that he and Dave keep each other motivated.
On 2023-05-03, Dave told Calvin he is teaming up with a local garage and shared a photo of a car being worked on in a garage.

On 2023-05-03, Calvin congratulated Dave on teaming up with a local garage, said it was super inspiring to see Dave follow his passion, and said it was impressive how far Dave has come since they last chatted; Calvin shared a photo of a green car in a garage with a sign in the background.

On 2023-05-03, Dave said he is loving his job, gets to work with awesome mechanics and share his knowledge about cars, and is currently working on a cool but challenging project; he shared a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage.
On 2023-05-03, Calvin said the car Dave is working on looks awesome, said Dave is putting in a lot of effort, and encouraged Dave to keep up the good work.

On 2023-05-03, Dave said he plans to keep learning more about auto engineering and maybe build a custom car from scratch someday, which he calls his dream; for now he plans to keep working on his current project and assisting customers.
On 2023-05-03, Calvin told Dave he is inspiring, said making a custom car sounds awesome, and advised Dave not to forget to relax and enjoy the process.
On 2023-05-03, Dave asked Calvin what hobbies help him relax.

On 2023-05-03, Calvin said long drives in a car help him relax because the feeling of the wind and the open road is freeing and helps him clear his head; he shared a photo of a red sports car driving down a road and asked Dave what he likes to do to chill out.
On 2023-05-03, Dave told Calvin that driving with the wind in his hair is calming and that walking around to explore sights and sounds is a peaceful way to destress.

On 2023-05-03, Calvin told Dave that embracing nature has been calming for him, that he has been loving getting to know Japanese culture, and that his music creativity feels frozen or stuck; Calvin asked Dave for tips.

On 2023-05-03, Dave advised Calvin that when he struggles for ideas he immerses himself in something he loves, such as concerts or favorite albums, to jumpstart inspiration; Dave suggested Calvin take a break from music, explore other things, and have fun.
On 2023-05-03, Calvin thanked Dave and said taking a break is great for getting his mojo back; Calvin said he will take Dave's advice and explore.
On 2023-05-03, Dave told Calvin he was glad to help, encouraged Calvin to keep pursuing music and never give up, and called Calvin awesome with a rock-on emoji.
On 2023-05-03, Calvin thanked Dave, said he won't give up, and proposed they stay in touch; Calvin said bye.
On 2023-05-03, Dave agreed to keep in touch and told Calvin to let him know if he ever needs help; Dave said bye.
Calvin's home in Tokyo got flooded about a week before 2023-05-16 (around 2023-05-08 to 2023-05-14), but he managed to save his music gear and his favorite microphone.
Calvin is waiting on insurance to kick in before he can start repairs on his flooded place; he is staying positive and looking forward to getting everything fixed up.
On 2023-05-16 Calvin shared a photo of his music studio with Dave, showing a keyboard, a synthesizer, and other musical equipment; he calls it his creative haven where he pours his heart into music.
Dave thought Calvin's music studio looked awesome and hoped Calvin gets it fixed soon so he can keep creating music.
On 2023-05-16 Dave offered to help Calvin however he could after hearing about the flood, telling him to stay positive.
Calvin told Dave on 2023-05-16 that he can't wait to get back to making music and asked Dave what exciting things he is working on.

Dave opened his own car maintenance shop last week (around 2023-05-01) and invited friends over to celebrate; he says it has been amazing and he is stoked to share his passion and help people with their cars.
On 2023-05-16 Calvin congratulated Dave on opening his own car shop, calling his excitement contagious and telling him to keep up the great work.
On 2023-05-16 Dave thanked Calvin for his support and said opening the shop has been quite a journey; he is excited to see what the future holds.
Calvin has an upcoming music performance in Tokyo in May 2023; he is excited to show his music to a whole new crowd and hopes to expand his following.
On 2023-05-16 Dave called Calvin 'Cal' and wished him all the luck for his Tokyo show, asking Calvin to let him know how it goes.
Calvin agreed to keep Dave posted on how his upcoming Tokyo performance goes.
On 2023-05-16 Calvin shared a photo with Dave of a city at night full of lights, saying 'Look what a wonderful night!'
records.topic: Shared photo of city at night

records.text: Calvin took a photo of Tokyo's night skyline in Tokyo on the night of 2023-05-15.
Calvin shared the Tokyo night skyline photo with Dave on 2023-05-16; Dave praised it as a great shot where the night skyline pops with city lights.
Dave plans to take a trip to Tokyo soon.
Calvin thinks Tokyo's city lights are amazing and encourages Dave to visit Tokyo, saying it's awesome.
Dave told Calvin he is definitely adding Tokyo (as suggested by Calvin) to his list and thanked him.

On 2023-05-31 at 6:06 pm, Calvin told Dave that he had been touring with Frank Ocean in the previous week; the Tokyo show was unreal, the crowd was insane, and Calvin felt so alive while performing, with crazy energy and love from fans.
records.topic: Calvin's Frank Ocean tour and Tokyo performance

records.text: On 2023-05-31, Dave shared a photo with Calvin showing a man working on a car engine in a garage; Dave said it was his neighbor's car, which had engine trouble, and that Dave fixed it himself.
Dave helps his neighbors with their cars and said it is not difficult for him to do so.

Dave finds working on cars therapeutic and is passionate about fixing up things; it gives him a sense of achievement and purpose, and he gets a buzz transforming something not working into something that runs smoothly, like giving it a second chance.
Calvin said working on cars helps him chill and clear his head; fixing cars calms him down and gives him a real sense of achievement, like meditating.
Calvin told Dave that they both make something great out of nothing when creating or collaborating, and that it feels amazing to see what they created through hard work and ideas.
Dave said that giving something a new life makes him feel powerful and happy, like he really achieved something.
Calvin loves performing live; he said it always fuels his soul and he loves the rush and connection with the crowd, an indescribable absolute high.
On 2023-05-31, Dave shared a photo with Calvin of a large crowd taking pictures of a concert, saying the atmosphere was off the charts.
On 2023-05-31, Calvin shared a photo with Dave of a crowd watching a concert with bright lights, saying everyone was part of it like one big harmony.
On 2023-05-31, Dave shared a photo with Calvin of a concert with a band performing on stage.
Dave said music really brings people together and creates a great atmosphere, like therapy for everyone.
On 2023-05-31, Dave asked Calvin what is next for his music.
On 2023-05-31, Calvin said he can't wait for his upcoming tour with Frank Ocean and is excited ('buzzing') to perform in Boston; he expects playing for people from home to be great.
records.topic: Calvin's Frank Ocean tour and Boston performance

records.text: On 2023-05-31, Calvin asked Dave what Dave thought of Boston's music scene.
On 2023-05-31, Dave told Calvin that Boston's music scene is awesome, with tons of talented musicians and cool places to play; Dave said Calvin performing there would be a blast.
On 2023-05-31, Dave said he would be in Boston to cheer Calvin on during Calvin's performance there.
On 2023-05-31, Calvin thanked Dave, saying Dave's support means a lot to him, and said he can't wait to experience Boston's music scene.
records.topic: Calvin's gratitude and Boston music scene

records.text: On 2023-05-31, Dave told Calvin to have a great time in Boston and said he can't wait to hear all about it when Calvin gets back.
Calvin told Dave he will fill him in on all the details when he gets back and said 'See you soon!'
Calvin plans to share details of the Frank Ocean tour and his Boston performance with Dave after returning.
On 2023-06-08, Calvin met with the creative team for his album; it was a long session and he found it awesome to see everything coming together.
Calvin is stoked about his album and has been making music with a team in the studio; Calvin says the studio is great for creativity.
On 2023-06-09 at 2:31 pm, Dave shared a photo with Calvin of a pond with a boat in it surrounded by trees.
On 2023-06-09 at 2:31 pm, Calvin shared a photo with Dave of a recording studio with a large window and a desk.
Dave told Calvin that working in a team yields incredible results and encouraged Calvin to keep pushing it.
Dave has been exploring parks on weekends to relax; Dave finds it peaceful being surrounded by nature and loves taking weekend walks because they recharge Dave for the entire upcoming week.
Dave went for a stroll on Friday 2023-06-02 and found it amazing and magical.
Calvin has never been to Boston; Calvin has heard Boston parks are amazing and cannot wait to visit Boston next month in July 2023.
Dave says Boston parks are awesome, especially in spring; walking around them is serene, and Dave bet Calvin will love it.
On 2023-06-09, Calvin shared a photo with Dave of a tree with pink flowers in the foreground.
Calvin is excited to experience serenity; Calvin cannot wait to take a walk in parks and recharge.
On 2023-06-09, Calvin shared a photo with Dave of a path going up a hill with a view of the mountains.
Dave has not gone hiking recently but thinks hiking and being in nature are awesome, push you to new heights, clear your mind, and bring a sense of calm.
Calvin has never been to the mountains but is keen to go; Calvin is looking for a way to escape and de-stress and wants to go on a hike to a place similar to the mountain photo.
On 2023-06-09, Calvin shared a photo with Dave of a plane flying over a mountain range with snow on the top.
Dave booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month in July 2023; Dave will finally see majestic peaks and expects it to be an amazing experience.
Dave plans to take lots of photos on Dave's mountain trip and show them to Calvin when Dave gets back; Calvin asked Dave to do so.
On 2023-06-09, Calvin wished Dave fun exploring the mountains and safe travels; Dave thanked Calvin; both said 'see you soon' and 'take care.'
Calvin had a minor car accident on Friday 16 June 2023; no one was hurt, but it was upsetting.

Calvin dealt with insurance and repairs after his 16 June 2023 car accident, which took up a lot of time and energy; the insurance process was a hassle with endless paperwork, but by 21 June 2023 it was all sorted and the car is being fixed.
Calvin is eager to drive his car again after the repairs from his June 2023 accident.
Calvin shared a photo of a red car with a black rim parked on a sidewalk, shown to Dave on 21 June 2023.
Calvin shared a photo of a tow truck parked in a parking lot, shown to Dave on 21 June 2023.
Dave expressed sympathy for Calvin's car accident, relief that nobody was hurt, and asked whether Calvin had encountered any insurance problems.
On 2023-06-21, Calvin told Dave that sorting out his car insurance and repairs after his 2023-06-16 minor accident only took a week; he had worried about the cost but it wasn't too bad.

On 2023-06-21, Calvin shared a photo from the auto repair shop showing a man working on a car in a garage; he identified the man as the mechanic, who knows the stuff and is doing his best to get Calvin's car running again.

On 2023-06-21, Calvin said he felt way more confident about his car repairs and excited to show off his car, trusting the mechanics' expertise; Dave agreed it's great that Calvin trusts the people fixing it and said the car will be back to normal soon.
On 2023-06-21, Calvin thanked Dave for his help and said he is excited to drive again; Dave addressed him as 'Cal'.
On 2023-06-21, Calvin shared a photo of the wonderful view from his living room: a small town with a mountain in the background.
Dave saw an amazing view photo shared by Calvin and asked where it was.
Dave said he had not seen anything like that view before.
Calvin told Dave the view was from a small town in Japan.
Calvin said the view of the mountains was unbelievably stunning.
Dave asked Calvin whether Calvin had gotten to the small town in Japan shown in the mountain-view photo yet.
On 2023-06-21 at 3:15 pm, Calvin shared a photo of a person on skis on a snowy mountain and said 'Look at that snowy peak.'

As of 2023-06-21, Calvin has not yet been to the mountains shown in the photo from a small town in Japan; visiting them is on his to-do list for after his tour with Frank Ocean ends, and he is eager to see them in person.
Dave asked Calvin on 2023-06-21 whether he had ever tried skiing, saying it looks like loads of fun.
Calvin has never tried skiing before; he said skiing looks like a lot of fun.
Calvin might give skiing a try once.
Calvin asked Dave what was new in Dave's daily routine.
Dave recently joined a rock band and has been practicing guitar.
Dave shared a photo of his rock band: a group of men playing instruments in a room.
Calvin thinks playing guitar in a rock band is awesome and will bring Dave a lot of emotions.
records.topic: Calvin's opinion on Dave's rock band

records.text: Dave believes good company and great music lift the mood and bring a lot of positive emotions.
records.topic: Dave's view on music and company

records.text: Dave had to leave the conversation and said he would see Calvin soon.
Calvin said goodbye, asked Dave to keep in touch, and told him to take care.
Dave plans to see Calvin soon.
On 2023-07-07, Calvin told Dave his car is fixed and running strong after the June 2023 crash. Calvin shared a photo of his red sports car parked on the side of the road.
Calvin loves cruising around in his car, calling it 'the best'.
As of 2023-07-07, Dave has been hanging out with friends at parks lately and arranged with friends to take regular walks together in the park.
Dave was glad to hear Calvin's car is fixed and going strong.
On 2023-07-07 at 7:56 pm, Dave told Calvin that he and friends were going to their favorite hangout spot that day, and shared a photo of a city skyline with a river and boats in the water.
Calvin thinks regular walks with friends are a wonderful way to spend time together and stay active, and that fresh air and buddies do wonders.

On 2023-07-07, Calvin shared a photo taken from his backyard of his Japanese mansion showing a boat docked in a canal at sunset, and said it reminded him of living in his Japanese mansion with the epic cityscape, which he calls a dream come true.
Calvin lives in a Japanese mansion with a city skyline view; he finds the city lights out the window awe-inspiring and describes it as luxury and beauty on a whole new level.

On 2023-07-07, Calvin shared a photo of the front part of his Japanese mansion: a large house with a lot of windows and lights. Dave said the mansion looks great and that the view from inside must be stunning.
Dave enjoys the peace by the river and finds it really nice.
Calvin is looking forward to trying Japanese food and checking out Japanese culture in Japan.

Dave has never been to Japan but is keen to go one day; he has heard Japan is full of vibes, good food and awesome tech, and says experiencing the culture would be amazing and that he is hooked on Japanese music.
Calvin says Japan has it all — vibes, food, tech and an amazing culture — and describes it as like stepping into another world.
As of 2023-07-07, Calvin has been working on cool music collaborations with Japanese artists and is excited to hear how it turns out.

On 2023-07-07 at 7:56 pm, Dave and Calvin had a conversation about Calvin's music collaboration with various artists (including Japanese artists). Dave said working with them is a great chance and he can't wait for the tunes. Calvin said he'll share clips when everything is ready.
Calvin plans to share clips of his music collaboration with Dave when everything is ready.
Calvin finds collaborating with various artists always exciting and a chance to create something unique.
Dave thinks collaborating with different artists to create something special sounds amazing and he can't wait to see or hear the end product of Calvin's project.
Calvin appreciates Dave's help with his music.
Calvin is excited about his music collaboration, saying it's gonna be awesome and he can't wait to show Dave.
Calvin ended the conversation with Dave on 2023-07-07 to get back to work, saying 'Take care'.
Dave told Calvin to take care, not overwork himself, and said he'll talk to him soon and to stay safe.
Dave returned from a road trip with his friends on 2023-07-21; they saw stunning countryside, drove on winding roads, took in views, and chatted, which recharged him after corporate mayhem.
Dave loves cars and driving; the 2023-07-21 road trip reminded him why he loves cars and recharged him.
Dave said reconnecting with his passion makes the long hours at his corporate job worth it.
Calvin responded to Dave's road trip news on 2023-07-21, saying it sounded awesome and that recharging with one's passion is awesome.
records.topic: Calvin's reaction to Dave's road trip

records.text: Dave shared a photo with Calvin on 2023-07-21 showing a person riding a motorcycle down a dirt road.
Dave asked Calvin on 2023-07-21 whether he had any recent moments that made him remember what he loves.
Calvin shared a photo showing progress on his project to transform a Japanese mansion into a recording studio: a room with a ladder in it.

Calvin is working on a project to transform a Japanese mansion into a recording studio — his dream of having a space for creating music with other artists, which he calls his sanctuary that reminds him why he loves music.
Dave complimented Calvin's progress on the recording studio, saying it looked amazing and must be fulfilling, and asked what kind of music Calvin has been creating there.

Calvin has been experimenting with different genres lately, pushing himself out of his comfort zone, and adding electronic elements to his songs for a fresh vibe — an exciting process of self-discovery and growth.
Dave asked Calvin whether moving between different musical styles presents any challenges.

Calvin says switching musical styles can be tough, but it's about finding the right balance between sticking to his own sound and trying new things; it can be intimidating but that's what makes it exciting and keeps him motivated.
On 2023-07-21 at 6:38 pm, Dave and Calvin had a conversation about dealing with pressure and staying motivated in music.
Calvin started making music to follow his dreams.
Calvin is stoked about how far he has come in his music career.
Calvin stays motivated by collaborating with others and learning from them.
Calvin surrounds himself with positive energy and passion.
Dave thinks Calvin's approach of surrounding himself with good vibes and collaborating with others is a great plan and encourages Calvin to keep going.
Dave considers himself Calvin's biggest fan and expresses strong support for Calvin's music career.
Calvin plans to keep pushing himself and striving for his goals.
Dave and Calvin agreed to chat again soon.
Calvin took his Ferrari for a service on 2023-08-03 and found it stressful; he is attached to his Ferrari.
Calvin asked Dave if he could relate to the stress of car service and what hobbies give him a feeling of being restored.
Dave understands the stress of getting a car serviced.
Dave finds fixing cars like therapy and refurbishing them gives him a sense of fulfillment.
Dave grew up working on cars with his dad.
Calvin expressed admiration for Dave's hobby that makes him proud and asked Dave to recall good memories from working on cars with his dad.
Dave has fond memories of working on cars with his dad as a kid; they spent one summer restoring an old car, which was hard work but satisfying to see the result and know they did it together.
Calvin believes that working together on projects like restoring a car brings people closer.
Calvin asked Dave if he has any pictures from the time he restored an old car with his dad.
Dave shared a photo of a man and a child posing for a picture, describing it as a wonderful experience.
Calvin shared a photo of his red Ferrari lifted on a lift in a garage.
Calvin said his Ferrari reminds him of his hard work and dedication, inspires him, and he is proud of it; seeing it every day keeps him motivated and reminds him to keep pushing.
Calvin mentioned a trip to the Ferrari dealership where he saw many amazing cars, but thinks his own car is the best.
Dave complimented Calvin's car, saying it looks great and that having something like that is motivating and a reminder of what one can achieve.
Dave asked Calvin about his biggest goal in music or otherwise.

Calvin's plan is to expand his brand worldwide, grow his fanbase, make his music reach more people and make an impact, work with artists from around the globe, and challenge himself to create special music.
Calvin performed with 'the boys' (a band) last night and shared a photo of the band playing on stage with lights.
Dave encouraged Calvin, saying working with different artists and crafting great sounds will help him reach his goals, and to keep making a difference.
Calvin expressed that Dave's support and encouragement mean a lot to him and he is determined to make his dreams come true; he will stay focused and keep going.
Dave told Calvin he is eager to see what he does and to keep at it and never forget his dreams.
Dave reminded Calvin to stay focused and keep going, saying 'You've got this!'
On 2023-08-11, Dave told Calvin he had been picked for a car mod workshop and shared a photo of a man standing in front of a car on a lift.
Calvin congratulated Dave on being picked for the car mod workshop and asked if there were any mods or projects Dave was excited to work on.
Dave said being picked for the car mod workshop was a dream come true because he had always wanted to learn auto engineering and build a custom car.
Dave shared a photo of a car being worked on by a mechanic, calling it the thrilling part of the workshop and saying seeing potential come to life is satisfying.
Dave has been working on a car doing engine swaps and suspension modifications, and is now learning body modifications; he is giving a classic muscle car a modern twist.
Dave shared a photo of a silver Corvette parked in front of a building.
Dave wanted his car to have a modern vibe while keeping classic muscle car style, and he was happy with the result.
Dave believes car customization is about small details that make a car unique and personalized, like customizing a work of art on wheels.
Dave shared a photo of his music studio setup, showing a desk with a keyboard, monitor, and keyboard pad, and said it has a high-quality sound system.
Dave offered to help Calvin with his music stuff and said Calvin's songs would sound amazing in Dave's music studio.
Calvin said he was super busy with his music at the moment, so he would keep Dave's offer of music help in mind.
Calvin encouraged Dave, saying Dave's enthusiasm and hard work show in everything he does and that Calvin is excited to see what Dave will do next; Calvin called Dave 'bud'.
